repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Deletes a dev.knotless.comment record from the account logged in to this appview's web pages, which must have written it, as `knotless comment delete` does. A pull or an issue is closed instead, and what others say the repository's owner hides. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Takes back a comment or review, as its author, logged in to this appview's pages.
